title: Dirk Nowitzki Appears at Lakers Minicamp in Slovenia
seoTitle: Dirk Nowitzki Appears at Lakers Minicamp in Slovenia
subtitle: The former Dallas star brings shooting expertise to the team
excerpt: Former Mavericks player Dirk Nowitzki was spotted at the Los Angeles Lakers minicamp in his home country of Slovenia.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The final day of the Los Angeles Lakers minicamp in Slovenia was marked by the presence of Holger Geschwindner, the shooting coach of Dirk Nowitzki. The visit took place at the same venue where Nowitzki ended his career in the 2018-19 season, the year Luka Dončić made his NBA debut.

dirk nowitzki and the lakers minicamp in slovenia

The minicamp, which featured nine new players and the departures of LeBron James, Marcus Smart, Rui Hachimura, Luke Kennard, and Jaxson Hayes, was designed for the team to learn how to play together before official training camp. Geschwindner's presence was highlighted by reporter Marc Stein.

the impact on improving player shooting

The Lakers need to strengthen their shooting from beyond the three-point line. The arrival of Quentin Grimes, Collin Sexton, Sandro Mamukelashvili, Matisse Thybulle, and potentially Cameron Carr and Jaden Hardy is expected to expand floor spacing. Geschwindner can contribute shooting techniques, which could especially benefit Dončić, who shot 36.6% from three-point range last season.

luka dončić and the quest for shooting efficiency

Dončić, who claimed his second league scoring title averaging 33.5 points per game, still shows potential for improvement in shooting efficiency. Geschwindner's guidance could be decisive in raising the player's three-point percentage.

the future of the lakers with the new roster

With the combination of new talent and the expertise of a former Maverick, the Lakers hope to enter the season with better preparation and synergy. The minicamp in Slovenia was an opportunity to test new training routines and integrate the players before the official start of the season.

With information from LeBron Wire.
